summary.text: Heather Meyer is a Democratic state representative who has represented District 29 since September 2021 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A social worker in the Kansas City area, she was appointed to the seat by the Johnson County Democrats.

paragraphs.text: Heather Meyer graduated from Olathe North Senior High in 1998 and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Kansas in 2006.
Her professional experience includes working as a social worker in the Kansas City area.
Meyer was appointed to the Kansas House by the Johnson County Democrats on August 24, 2021, to succeed Brett Parker, who resigned that month, and took office on September 7, 2021.
For 2025 and 2026 she is assigned to the Insurance, House Federal and State Affairs, Health and Human Services, and Elections committees.
